name: CollectionFolder
notes: Figma is not linked yet. Collapse state is read from the global collection-collapse store (bindings are mocked in Storybook). Dragging is driven by the shared use:draggable action and the dnd drag store, not by props; the stories set that store directly. The drag ghost is a clone of the row on bg-elevation-2. The folder row highlights with bg-hovered and a ring-primary when the drop means "into this folder"; the insertion line between messages is bg-primary.
